topics: 公共屋顶上的社区能源机会
title: Public roofs for community energy
titleZh: 公共屋顶上的社区能源机会
summaryZh: 苏格兰公布21处潜在项目地点，并为社区提供技术与资金信息；潜在机会不等于已经建成。

sentences.text: On 18 November 2026, the Scottish Government announced new opportunities for local energy projects.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月18日，苏格兰政府公布了地方能源项目的新机会。

sentences.text: It identified 21 possible sites on public land and in public buildings across Scotland.
sentences.zh: 它在苏格兰各地的公共土地和公共建筑中确定了21处可能的项目地点。

sentences.text: These are places where communities could develop projects, not 21 completed energy schemes.
sentences.zh: 这些是社区可以开发项目的地点，并非21个已完成的能源项目。

sentences.text: Some opportunities are on the roofs of hospitals and courts.
sentences.zh: 有些机会位于医院和法院的屋顶上。

sentences.text: For example, solar panels could be put on Queen Margaret Hospital in Fife or Glasgow Sheriff Court.
sentences.zh: 例如，可以考虑在法夫的Queen Margaret医院或格拉斯哥Sheriff Court法院安装太阳能板。

sentences.text: Other possible sites include business parks, development land and research campuses.
sentences.zh: 其他可能的地点包括商业园区、待开发土地和研究园区。

sentences.text: Interested communities can contact Local Energy Scotland for advice and technical support.
sentences.zh: 有兴趣的社区可以联系Local Energy Scotland，获取建议和技术支持。

glosses.note: technical support指技术支持；此处为不可数名词。

sentences.text: They can also ask about funding through the government’s Community and Renewable Energy Scheme, called CARES.
sentences.zh: 它们还可以了解政府的社区与可再生能源计划，即CARES，提供的资金支持。

sentences.text: Community energy is not a completely new idea in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 社区能源在苏格兰并非一个全新的想法。

sentences.text: In Wallacetown, solar panels on three schools are expected to raise about £1 million for local investment over 25 years.
sentences.zh: 在Wallacetown，三所学校的太阳能板预计将在25年内为当地投资带来约100万英镑。

glosses.note: be expected to表示预期，不是已经实现。

sentences.text: That figure is an expected result over many years, not money already received.
sentences.zh: 这个数字是多年内的预期成果，而不是已经收到的资金。

words.note: technical support指技术支持；此处为不可数名词。
be expected to表示预期，不是已经实现。

sentences.note: could表示可能性，不说明项目已经实施。
are expected to表示预期；over引出收入累积的时间跨度。

questions.text: Which public building near you could use solar panels?
questions.zh: 你附近哪座公共建筑可以使用太阳能板？
